description.value: Yalla is a family-owned Middle Eastern street-eats restaurant in Victoria serving halal shawarma, falafel, and Persian-inspired dishes across pita and bowl formats. The kitchen draws on culinary traditions from multiple Middle Eastern countries, with standout items like the Persian shawarma and lamb shank with baghali polo. The team is openly accommodating of food allergies including gluten and nuts, making it a welcoming stop for cyclists with dietary restrictions.
